questions.question: After Israel crossed the Jordan River, what did the LORD tell twelve men to take up from the middle of the river?
Joshua said twelve stones from the Jordan River would be a sign for Israel. Who would one day ask what they mean?
Joshua told Israel why the LORD dried up the Jordan River for them to cross. What reason did he give?

answers.text: So all peoples know His hand is mighty
So Israel could rest before the battle
So the priests could reach Jericho first

questions.question: When the Amorite and Canaanite kings heard how the LORD dried up the Jordan River for Israel, how did they react?

answers.text: They gathered their armies to attack
They sent gifts asking for peace
